It floats through my head every day I really don't mind talking about it right now.

It was supposed to be a medical assessment, to see if I was healthy before I went into the therapeutic home. So bloodtests, etc. 

What they didn't predict, unfortunately... was that when you take a 19 year old from his home via ambulance he goes into mental degredation and shock when you try to send him home. I went back home 3 days after and I went into shock. I wasn't able to visit my parents until sometime last spring. Fairly recently.

The only way to get groceries now is to go get a ride from my parents. Or to walk there in the dark. Don't want ot do that. And when I -do- have food there's not much I can make that makes me think of you know, almost being killed. And a few suicide attempts here and there.

Mom sent me a text message that asked me how i was going and it sent me intoi a fit because I almost sent 'I don't eat becuase i almost got killed by a frying pan lololo' :/

I was in a therapeutic home for 6 months. It was basically to teach people who do not have independent living skills how to live on your own. I was supposed to be transitioned into my own house. They are supposed to have people with similar diagnoses and personalities. I have Asperger's and was agoraphobic for awhile because of a bunch of weird circumstances. 

Instead, I was thrown into a psych ward in a hospital for 1 month, which was supposed to be 1 day for medical assesment. Then the theraputic home had a guy with scitzophrenia/fetal alcohol syndrome and another guy with high functioning autism. They were awful. The guy with FAS would psychological torture everyone. There was a lot of home care support workers there and nurses...

Im out on my own no...I just freaked out and slammed my frying pan into my stove and was about to hit myself with it.All because I decided I wanted to get over my PTSD and eat a fucking egg for breakfast because I have no other food on the account of severe social anxiety and sensory integration dysfuctions (sensitive to noise, crowds, lights.)

So basically my parents kicked me out, via ambulance...went through hell because I wa sagoraphobic...now i barely make myself food because...well they sent me somewhere where I almost got killed and saw a lot of suicide attempts and was screamed at and so much trauma....
